resume: About 3,000 billionaires own roughly one third of the wealth, and over a third of the world's 50 biggest corporations, worth a combined $13.3 trillion, are run or substantially owned by billionaires. The richest 1% hold more than the bottom 95% combined, and billionaire wealth keeps growing exponentially, giving them massive influence over global economies.
